scripts.dev-all: concurrently "npm run dev-webapp" "npm run dev-mobileapp" "npm run dev-services"
scripts.dev-webapp: concurrently "cd webapp && npm run dev" "npm run dev-services"
scripts.dev-mobileapp: concurrently "cd mobileapp && npm run dev" "npm run dev-services"
scripts.dev-services: concurrently "cd api-gateway && npm run dev" "cd services/database-service && npm run dev" "cd services/movie-service && npm run dev" "cd services/showing-service && npm run dev" "cd services/ticket-service && npm run dev" "cd services/user-service && npm run dev"
scripts.install-all: npm install && concurrently "npm run install-frontend" "npm run install-services"
scripts.install-frontend: concurrently "cd webapp && npm install" "cd mobileapp && npm install & npx expo install expo"
scripts.install-services: concurrently "cd api-gateway && npm install" "cd services/database-service && npm install" "cd services/movie-service && npm install" "cd services/showing-service && npm install" "cd services/ticket-service && npm install" "cd services/user-service && npm install"
